about.heroQuestion: Why does almost everyone in Brazil call solar protection films "insulfilm"?
about.heroText: INSULFILM™ is the first and most recognized film brand in Brazil for automotive and architectural glass. Over 35 years innovating in films for glass and metallic surfaces. Since 1986, INSULFILM™ has revolutionized how Brazilians experience their glazed environments, transforming this experience into comfort and protection with sophistication.
about.timelineClosing: INSULFILM™ doesn't protect glass, it protects you.

timeline.e1986: We inaugurated the solar protection film market in Brazil, ensuring exclusive innovation with registered patents from the start.
timeline.e1996: World's largest glass film distributor, title granted by the world's largest industry at the time, headquartered in the USA.
timeline.e1996b: First to offer architectural anti-vandalism and security protection films — INSULFILM™ SafetySecurityFilm.
timeline.e1997: First to offer films manufactured by OEM system with specific characteristics for the Brazilian climate.
timeline.e1998: We led the change in the sector by directly supporting Contran regulation for the commercialization of automotive films.
timeline.e2000: First to offer automotive anti-vandalism and security protection films in Brazil — INSULFILM™ Blindado.
timeline.e2001: First film brand to open an official store for direct consumer service — Official INSULFILM™ Store, Água Branca, SP.
timeline.e2001b: First to remove car windows for application of anti-vandalism protection films.
timeline.e2008: First to offer automotive film with photochromic effect and superior technology to block heat — INSULFILM™ Elite.
timeline.e2011: Brazil's first architectural project with custom glass films for ballistic resistance.
timeline.e2012: Sale of the first glass film service franchise in Brazil — Official INSULFILM™ Store, Ribeirão Preto.
timeline.e2018: First to offer films with high definition technology — INSULFILM™ Elite.
timeline.e2019: Launch of premium paint protection film (PPF) — INSULFILM™ Phantom 8mil.
timeline.e2024: Launch of ultra definition technology — INSULFILM™ Elite, Polariz and Matrix.
timeline.e2025: Launch of Eclipse, Skye Ultra, Panoramic films and the new "Superior Security Films" category for automotive glass.

faq1.q: Which film is recommended for my car?
faq1.a: The choice depends on your needs. For thermal comfort, we recommend the Eclipse or VIP line. For security, the Anti-Vandalism 13K. For paint protection, the Phantom PPF. Our team can help with technical consulting.

faq2.q: Does the film darken the glass too much?
faq2.a: Each line has different visible light transmission (VLT) levels. We offer options from light tints to maximum darkening allowed by legislation. The important thing is to respect CONTRAN limits.

faq3.q: How long does the film last?
faq3.a: Durability varies by line. Original INSULFILM™ films are designed to last years without discoloring or peeling, with factory warranty that proves the quality.

faq4.q: How do I know if the film is original?
faq4.a: Every original INSULFILM™ film has an authenticity certificate with a verifiable QR Code. Additionally, only authorized dealers have access to original products. Be wary of prices well below market value.

faq5.q: Can the film be applied to any glass?
faq5.a: Yes, we have films for all types of automotive glass, including windshields (with authorization), side windows, rear window and sunroof. Each glass can receive the most suitable film for your needs.

glossary.mechContent: Tensile Strength: maximum force the film withstands before breaking. Rupture Force: load required to break the film. Pull-out Force: adhesive resistance to detachment. Elongation at Break: stretching capacity before rupture. Puncture Force: resistance to point perforation.
glossary.solarContent: VLT (Visible Light Transmission): percentage of visible light passing through the film. UV Rejection: ability to block ultraviolet rays. Optical Clarity: transparency and visual clarity quality of the applied film.

reality.title: The Reality of Break-Ins in Brazil
reality.subtitle: Your car window is the most vulnerable entry point. The numbers don't lie.
reality.stat1: Every 8 minutes, a vehicle is broken into by glass smashing in São Paulo.
reality.stat2: Over 180 thousand vehicles broken into per year in the state of SP.
reality.stat3: 73% of break-ins happen through side window smashing.
reality.source: Sources: SSP-SP, Atlas of Violence (IPEA), Brazilian Public Safety Forum.

danger.title: The Danger Goes Beyond Property Damage
danger.subtitle: Tempered glass shatters into hundreds of fragments. Without film, these shards hit everyone inside the vehicle — face, eyes, arms.
danger.shardsDesc: When broken, tempered glass fragments into hundreds of pieces that scatter inside the vehicle with force and speed.
danger.eyesDesc: Glass fragments can directly hit occupants' eyes, causing severe injuries and even vision loss.
danger.skinDesc: Shards cut exposed skin, arms, hands and face. Wounds that can leave permanent scars.
danger.childrenDesc: Children in the back seat are in the highest risk zone. Thinner skin, slower reflexes, greater consequences.

family.title: Protect Those You Love
family.message1: Your family is in the back seat. An act of vandalism may last seconds, but the scars can last forever.
family.message2: The film is not an accessory. It's a layer of protection between danger and the people you love most.
family.message3: The film doesn't just protect the glass. It protects the skin, the eyes and the peace of mind of those you love most.

ctaMid.title: Don't wait for it to happen. Protect now.
ctaMid.subtitle: Safety is not a luxury. It's a necessity.

privacy.heroSubtitle: Learn how INSULFILM™ collects, uses and protects your personal data, in compliance with Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD — Law No. 13,709/2018).
privacy.introText:
INSULFILM™ respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, store and share information when you access our website or use our services.

By using our website, you agree to the practices described in this policy.
privacy.dataText:
We may collect the following types of data:

• Identification data: name, email, phone number (when voluntarily provided through contact or quote forms).
• Browsing data: IP address, browser type, pages visited, time spent, traffic source and device used.
• Approximate location data: based on IP address, for statistical analysis purposes.
privacy.cookiesText:
We use cookies and tracking technologies to improve user experience and analyze website performance. The tools used include:

• Google Analytics 4 (GA4): collects anonymized browsing data for traffic and behavior analysis.
• Google Tag Manager (GTM): manages third-party scripts and tags on the site.
• Microsoft Clarity: records browsing sessions (heatmaps and recordings) for usability analysis, without capturing sensitive personal data.

You can manage or disable cookies in your browser settings.
privacy.purposeText:
Collected data is used for the following purposes:

• Responding to contact and quote requests.
• Improving browsing experience and website performance.
• Conducting statistical analysis of access and behavior.
• Sending relevant communications about products and services (only with your consent).
• Complying with legal and regulatory obligations.
privacy.sharingText:
Your personal data is not sold, rented or transferred to third parties for commercial purposes. We may share information with:

• Essential service providers (hosting, data analysis), under confidentiality agreements.
• Competent authorities, when required by law or court order.
• INSULFILM™ franchisees and authorized stores, exclusively to fulfill requests made by you.
privacy.rightsText:
Under Brazil's General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13,709/2018), you have the right to:

• Confirm the existence of data processing.
• Access your personal data.
• Correct incomplete, inaccurate or outdated data.
• Request anonymization, blocking or deletion of unnecessary data.
• Request data portability to another provider.
• Revoke consent at any time.
• Obtain information about sharing of your data.

To exercise your rights, please contact us through the channels listed below.
privacy.retentionText: Your personal data is stored for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, or as required by legal, contractual or regulatory obligations. Browsing data collected by analytics tools follows each platform's retention policies (Google, Microsoft).
privacy.securityText: We adopt appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, loss, alteration or destruction. This includes use of secure connection (HTTPS), restricted access control and periodic review of our security practices.
privacy.contactText:
For questions, requests or to exercise your rights related to privacy and data protection, please contact us:

• Email: privacidade@insulfilm.com.br
• Phone: +55 (11) 3611-2474

privacy.updatesText: This Privacy Policy may be updated periodically to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. We recommend that you review this page regularly. Any significant changes will be communicated visibly on the website.
